baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ joins the favor to its giver before the imperative فَحَدِّثْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bestowed well-being is verbally renewed as news whose ownership and source remain with the Lord; telling is attribution, not a display of autonomous possession.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor and good condition supply the content to be acknowledged.
Lordship and ownership keep the favor attributed to its sovereign source.
Renewed speech and news provide the literal vehicle for acknowledgment.

changed_reading.before: Mention a blessing that you possess.
changed_reading.after: Give renewed verbal account of bestowed well-being while naming it as your Lord's, not as self-produced property.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative force latent in حَدِّثْ meets a favor governed by a nurturing رَبّ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Speech does not merely describe a finished gift: it makes the Lord's ongoing nurture newly present and perceptible in a social field.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and gradual completion make the favor an ongoing process rather than a finished object.
Coming to be after not being lets the telling itself count as a fresh event of the favor.
Manifesting what was not visible gives the speech a performative disclosure function.

changed_reading.before: Report a completed favor after the fact.
changed_reading.after: By telling, make the Lord's still-operative nurture newly occur in visibility.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نِعْمَة and حَدِّثْ permit the utterance to be praise and responsive affirmation as well as information.
baseline_models.mechanism: The command recruits the praise-form and affirmative 'yes' branches of ن ع م, so the account becomes an answer of assent to the goodness received.

activation_trace.role: Praising something as excellent turns the report into evaluative praise.
Affirming with 'yes' supplies a responsive posture toward the gift.
Conversation and renewed report carry that praise and assent into speech.

changed_reading.before: Transmit neutral information about a favor.
changed_reading.after: Answer the favor with an audible 'yes': renew it as praise, assent, and report at once.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The unusual polishing branch of ح د ث remains attached to the imperative, while نِعْمَة and رَبّ supply softness and repair.
baseline_models.mechanism: Recounting can polish a dulled heart or perception: nurture is recollected until the received good becomes clear again, so the first audience of the telling may be the teller.

activation_trace.role: Softness and ease make the recovered texture of favor something that can soften perception.
Repair and completion frame recollection as part of the Lord's formative care.
Polishing a sword or heart supplies the strange but explicit image of speech removing accumulated dullness.

changed_reading.before: Publicize the favor for other people.
changed_reading.after: Rehearse the favor as a polishing remembrance that restores the teller's own capacity to perceive the Lord's care.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus roots themselves contain adding, increase, and fresh occurrence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The non-dominant growth mapping of رَبّ converges with carrying an act further in ن ع م and new occurrence in ح د ث; telling can therefore continue or increase the favor's effects.

activation_trace.role: Adding and going further recasts favor as extensible action.
The split mapping's increase and elevation image supplies growth without replacing the ordinary Lord-reading.
Fresh occurrence makes each telling a possible new increment rather than a duplicate.

changed_reading.before: Catalogue a fixed stock of past favors.
changed_reading.after: Carry the favor further by generating fresh effects through each responsible telling.

context_deltas.mechanism: Morning emergence after a covering, stilled night, followed by the denial of abandonment and heart-distance, makes disclosure a timed emergence from latency: what was covered was not absent or discarded.

activation_trace.role: Manifestation anchors the changed reading directly in the focus imperative.
Emergence into the sun supplies the opening phase in which a preserved favor becomes visible.
Covering with a cloth gives the preceding quiet interval a containing rather than annihilating function.
Deposit and entrustment make non-abandonment compatible with something held in safekeeping.
Heart-distancing aversion, explicitly negated, blocks a reading of silence as rejection.

structural_cues: The packet orders bright morning, the night when it settles, then a double negation of abandonment and aversion before the later imperative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emergence, covering, safekeeping, and negated distancing; I infer that a latent favor can be preserved through silence and that telling marks its emergence. A live alternative is that the opening sequence only consoles and does not specify the timing of speech.

changed_reading.before: Make an already obvious blessing public at any time.
changed_reading.after: Bring a preserved favor out of cover when its opening arrives, refusing to mistake latency for abandonment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later being more beneficial than the first, together with outcome and uninterrupted succession images, turns favor into an unfinished trajectory whose account can register growth and destination.

activation_trace.role: Going further supplies the focus-side capacity for favor to exceed its current state.
New occurrence lets the account register increments still arriving.
Later-after-first supplies the temporal comparison that prevents a closed inventory.
Beneficial good gives the later movement a qualitative direction rather than mere chronology.
Return to outcome or final issue lets the first stage be read through what it is becoming.
The split mapping's uninterrupted succession gives the trajectory a step-after-step mechanism.

structural_cues: The explicit comparative in 93:4 places a later term against a first term and assigns greater good to the later.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a better-later comparison, outcome, succession, fresh occurrence, and going further; I infer that telling should preserve an unfolding arc rather than freeze the gift at its first appearance. The alternative is a simple two-state promise with no implication for how 93:11 is narrated.

changed_reading.before: List the favors that have already arrived.
changed_reading.after: Tell the favor as an open trajectory—first stage, present increment, and beneficial issue still becoming.

context_deltas.mechanism: A promised hand-to-hand giving from the nurturing Lord toward satisfaction activates speech as the next transfer in a gift circuit: received benefit is made available to another through intelligible account.

activation_trace.role: Benefaction reaching another makes favor transferable in effect without changing its divine source.
Report and conversation become the medium of onward delivery.
Handing and giving supply the first transfer in the relay.
Nurture and completion identify the giving as formative care, not a detachable commodity.
Mutual satisfaction supplies a relational horizon for how the relayed account lands.

structural_cues: The future gift in 93:5 is followed by a result clause of satisfaction, creating giver-to-recipient movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies giving, nurture, relational satisfaction, and later speech; I supply the arrow from receiving to verbally re-giving benefit. A live alternative is that 93:5 only promises consolation and leaves 93:11 as private gratitude.

changed_reading.before: Describe what was given to you.
changed_reading.after: Relay the received good through speech so that a gift to you becomes usable benefit between persons.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated pattern of encountering a condition and then transforming it supplies the content-form for حَدِّثْ: the favor is narrated as a sequence of before-and-after transitions, not named as a static noun.

activation_trace.role: Gradual nurture and completion unify the three transformations as one formative mechanism.
Narrated news anchors the resulting testimony form in the focus command.
Encountering a concrete condition opens the first before-and-after unit.
Severance from a caregiver gives the initial condition its relational deficit.
Joining a sheltering side supplies the reversal from severance to inclusion.
Hiddenness supplies a live condition that is changed by being gently led into a way.
Gentle indication toward a path supplies the second transformative result.
Poverty and need supply the third exposed condition.
Sufficiency supplies the third result without requiring an absolute-riches reading.

structural_cues: 93:6-8 repeat an encountered condition followed by فَ and a transforming verb: orphaned then sheltered, hidden or astray then guided, needy then made sufficient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three parallel condition-to-result clauses and focus speech; I infer that this repeated grammar teaches the account's narrative shape. The alternative is that the three clauses are independent evidences and حَدِّثْ asks only for a generic mention.

changed_reading.after: Testify by tracing concrete passages from severance to shelter, hiddenness to direction, and need to sufficiency.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory's scattering image is reversed by the context's severance-and-shelter pair; telling gathers a once-disconnected life into a shareable account and can restore social cohesion.

activation_trace.role: Departure and scattering expose a negative edge from which favor can be read as recovered cohesion.
Becoming an account carried among people gives reassembled experience a communal memory form.
Singularity and severance sharpen the initial condition as social disconnection.
Joining a gathering shelter supplies the counter-motion from dispersion to belonging.

structural_cues: The orphan condition recurs in 93:9, carrying the remembered severance from autobiography into a social obligation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies scattering, singular severance, joining, and public account; I infer a cohesion-restoring arc. The live alternative is that the ostrich-scattering branch is only an idiomatic lexical neighbor and should not organize the verse.

changed_reading.after: Reassemble a history of severance into communal memory that can gather rather than isolate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two vulnerable-object prohibitions and the focus command form a three-part pragmatic frame: speech about favor is invalidated if it reproduces domination from above or harsh verbal expulsion.

activation_trace.role: Benefaction reaching another keeps the focus on received and transmissible good rather than status.
Actual speech anchors the contextual constraints in the manner and effect of telling.
Loss of a caregiver identifies a hearer or neighbor especially exposed to power.
Humiliating conquest from above supplies the forbidden social geometry.
Asking and seeking place the account beside a person whose need calls for response.
Harsh verbal rebuke supplies the explicitly forbidden speech mode.

structural_cues: 93:9, 93:10, and 93:11 are a closing triad built with فَأَمَّا or وَأَمَّا and an imperative or prohibition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel marked cases, vulnerable addressees, domination, harsh speech, and then telling; I infer that the first two commands constrain the third's pragmatics. The alternative is that all three are coordinated but independent duties.

changed_reading.before: Speak freely about your favored status.
changed_reading.after: Tell in a way that cannot crush the unprotected, repel the asker, or convert received favor into rank over them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Question, requested object, and fulfillment activate the focus utterance as an answer: telling is responsive to a real ask rather than compulsory self-broadcast.

activation_trace.role: Affirmative 'yes' gives the favor-account the posture of an answer.
Conversation and report provide the focus-side act of responding.
Question and request supply the initiating address to which telling may answer.
Fulfilling a request makes an adequate answer, not mere talk, the relational goal.

structural_cues: The asker immediately precedes the final marked case, وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an asker, request-fulfillment, affirmation, and conversational report; I infer a question-answer adjacency across the verse boundary. The alternative is that السائل denotes only a material petitioner and does not solicit this account.

changed_reading.before: Broadcast blessing without regard to occasion or listener.
changed_reading.after: Let the account be a fitting affirmative answer to inquiry or need, measured by whether it fulfills rather than repels.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines meteorological branches rather than treating them as lexical glosses for the surface forms. It remains anchored in the focus through the soft-wind branch of نِعْمَة and speech branch of حَدِّثْ, while the opening light and closing ban on harsh speech shape its function. Render it only as an atmospheric analogy for manner: clear and life-bearing, not a claim that نِعْمَة literally means wind here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نِعْمَة can carry a soft moist wind image, and فَحَدِّثْ supplies the speech whose manner that image alters.

activation_trace.role: A soft moist south wind supplies a gentle, sustaining atmospheric quality for the telling.
Spoken report is the focus act whose felt climate is being reimagined.
Clear morning light adds lucidity and opening to the speech climate.
The ban on harsh rebuke provides the contrast that keeps the imagined wind gentle rather than battering.

changed_reading.before: Telling is judged only by the information conveyed.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, let the account arrive like clear, moisture-bearing air: perceptible and enlivening without verbal violence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is branch-distant because it uses the non-dominant س ل ل mapping behind the asker's root. It remains valid as a contrast anchored in the focus command to manifest and speak: disclose your own received favor rather than drawing out another person's concealed deprivation. Downstream prose should mark it as an ethical inference from the split mapping, not as the surface meaning of السائل.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The imperative حَدِّثْ directs disclosure of the addressee's own received favor, giving a stable focus-side contrast with extraction from the asker.

activation_trace.role: Manifesting something anchors the positive disclosure on the teller's side.
The teller's bestowed favor, rather than the asker's lack, supplies what is to be exposed.
Gentle hidden extraction supplies the surprising risk of drawing out what belongs to the vulnerable other.
Harsh rebuke identifies the overtly violent version of the same asymmetrical encounter.

changed_reading.before: Make vulnerability tell its story, then speak about blessing.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, refuse to extract the asker's hidden need; expose your own dependence on received favor instead.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is unusual because it reads favor spatially through a place that suits its inhabitant and sufficiency-in-place. It stays anchored in the focus noun نِعْمَة and is strongly activated by sheltering inclusion in 93:6. Render it as a coexisting emplacement model—being given inhabitable belonging—not as an exclusive replacement for material or spiritual favor.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The suitable-settlement branch belongs to the focus root ن ع م and therefore can spatialize the favor named in 93:11.

activation_trace.role: A place agreeing with and settling its occupant makes favor an inhabitable fit.
Narrated account lets that acquired belonging become testimony.
Joining a sheltering side provides the concrete transition into belonging.
Sufficiency in a place stabilizes shelter as dwelling rather than temporary cover.

changed_reading.before: Favor is a portable possession or inward state.
changed_reading.after: Favor can also be the making of an inhabitable place in which a formerly unprotected person can belong and become sufficient.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most form-distant activation because it uses the non-dominant ه د د inventory mapped from ه د ي, contrasting lullaby with loud din and threat. It remains anchored by the focus's softness and speech branches and by the explicit ban on harsh speech. Render it only as a contained acoustic analogy: guidance-context sensitizes how the final telling sounds; it does not make هَدَى mean lullaby in 93:7.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Softness in نِعْمَة and spoken report in حَدِّثْ allow the context's opposed sound images to modify the acoustic ethics of the focus command.

activation_trace.role: Softness supplies the focus-side quality that a soothing telling preserves.
Actual speech gives the acoustic contrast a direct focus anchor.
Lulling a child to sleep supplies a protective and settling sound image.
Loud din supplies the acoustic alternative that would overwhelm rather than settle.
The forbidden harsh rebuke makes the contrast ethically relevant to the final speech command.

changed_reading.before: The more forcefully blessing is proclaimed, the better the command is fulfilled.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the account may fulfill its guidance function by settling the exposed hearer like a lullaby rather than arriving as din or threat.

strongest_changes: The focus-only reading shifted from static report to performative manifestation: telling can make ongoing nurture newly present.
The repeated condition-to-result clauses turned the content of telling into transformation testimony rather than a blessing inventory.
The closing triad constrained the speech ethically: an account of favor must not reproduce domination, rebuke, or self-elevation over vulnerable hearers.
Question and gift branches kept a coexisting relational reading alive: telling can answer, fulfill, and relay benefit rather than merely broadcast.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive activation came from crossings rather than single glosses: concealment with manifestation, gift with conversation, severance with shelter, and the two prohibitions with the final imperative. Split-root branches also opened contained acoustic and non-extractive readings without displacing the dominant senses.
remaining_uncertainties: The degree to which non-dominant split mappings should shape prose rather than remain experimental marginalia.
Whether the three closing marked cases directly govern one another's pragmatics or are simply adjacent independent duties.
Whether telling literally extends the favor's causal effects or only changes the teller's and hearer's perception of an already complete gift.
Whether the responsive-answer model requires an informational asker or can operate when the asker is solely a material petitioner.
